message: You're a nauseating example of everything that's wrong with our discourse. You come here, pretending to be some kind of champion of the people, but really you're just a phony, using your sanctimonious tone to disguise your own intellectual bankruptcy. Your whole argument is a carefully crafted exercise in bad faith, designed to shut down any actual discussion and impose your smug, liberal orthodoxy on the rest of us. Newsflash: it's not working. You're not fooling anyone with your condescending lectures and your transparent attempts to gaslight the audience. The truth is, you don't belong in a serious discussion about this topic, or any topic for that matter. You're a charlatan, a hack, and a coward who can't even defend your own position without resorting to sneering at your opponents and calling them names. You're a perfect example of why we can't have a real conversation about anything: because people like you are more interested in winning an argument than in actually engaging with the issue at hand. Well, let me tell you something, sweetheart: you're not winning. You're losing, badly. And if you keep up this kind of behavior, you'll be lucky to get out of this debate with your dignity intact.
